author: Goodpart
name: The Imperial Palace
bootlegger: View running notes and homebrew almanac at menagerie.towerrangers.net

name: Gatekeeper
ability: Each night*, if you nominated today, learn one not-in-play character. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: If the Gatekeeper nominated today, the Gatekeeper learns a not-in-play character.

name: Record Keeper
ability: If you are executed, the Demon sees the Grimoire tonight.
flavor: You would be surprised as to what people are capable of when they think nobody is watching.
otherNightReminder: If the Record Keeper has died by execution today, show the Demon the Grimoire.

jinxes.reason: If a Damsel is in play, they are drunk when the Record Keeper dies.
If the Poppy Grower is in play and the Record Keeper dies, the Demon does not see the Grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.

name: Shogun
ability: All players know you are the Shogun. Minions & Demons do not know each other. Each day, publicly choose a player: they die. After execution, players may nominate you & if executed while Minions live, your team wins. [+1 Minion, No Outsiders]
flavor: 分をわきまえろ痴者が。

jinxes.reason: The Scarlet Woman cannot become the Demon. Instead, the Scarlet Woman instead gains the ability of the first Minion to die.
The Goblin's ability no longer ends the game. Instead, if the Goblin's ability would trigger, they may immediately choose a player: they die.
If a Mastermind's ability would trigger, players must execute a living player that day. If that player is good, evil wins.
The Shogun learns who the Spy is. The Spy does not see the Grimoire, but instead learns which Minions are in play.
The Widow learns who the Shogun is. The Widow does not see the Grimoire, but instead learns which Minions are in play.
If the Boomdandy's ability would trigger, the Shogun must die. Good wins if a Minion is chosen. If the Boomdandy is the only living Minion, the Boomdandy's ability does not trigger.
The Slayer can use their ability on Minions.
If the Record Keeper is executed, the Shogun does not see the Grimoire: they instead learn who their Minions are.
The Shogun does not receive bluffs. If the Poppy Grower dies, the Shogun and Minions instead learn players who are dead Minions.
The Magician is also announced as the Shogun. The Shogun must tell the Storyteller who they are killing privately.
The Lunatic is also announced as the Shogun. If they target a Minion with their ability, that Minion might die. If they target the Shogun with their ability, their team loses.
If the Mayor is killed by the Demon when 3 players live, the Mayor's team wins.
